operator_assessment.operator_summary: This export changes exactly one tournament: rvv-0024 (Sandefjord Penguins, U9) moved from 2026-10-31 (Halloween) to 2026-12-06, same arena/host/start time. All 183 tournaments verify cleanly (ok=true, zero violations), export formats are internally consistent, and the deterministic publication scope is ELIGIBLE with rvv-0024 correctly classified as a proposed placement, not booked. The move introduces no regressions: all 8 previously participating teams keep their original game counts.

key_tradeoffs.title: Booking confirmation not yet transferred
key_tradeoffs.summary: The prior Sandefjord confirmation applied to the 31 Oct interval only; the new 6 Dec placement is unapproved/pending review and must publish as awaiting confirmation rather than booked.

remaining_actions.title: Get Sandefjord to confirm 2026-12-06
remaining_actions.summary: Ice availability at Bugarden ishall for the new date is supported by the trusted, coverage-complete calendar source (only the club's normal recurring off-window ice time overlaps, leaving 15:00-18:00 free) but has not been explicitly confirmed by the club; publish as proposed and record confirmation via season booking-set/approve once received.

limitations: The season-wide REVIEW_REQUIRED status (hosting-balance imbalances, manual/external calendar placements, participation shortfalls, unplaced obligations) is pre-existing planning debt unrelated to this change and is out of scope for this incremental publication.

checklist_findings.question: Antall cuper pr lag?
checklist_findings.finding: Unchanged by this scoped republish; only rvv-0024's date changed and its 8-team roster is identical, so per-team tournament counts are unaffected by this delta. Season-wide per-team counts are pre-existing planning state, not part of this change.

checklist_findings.question: Antall hjemmeturneringer pr lag?
checklist_findings.finding: Sandefjord Penguins keeps hosting exactly the same tournament, just on a new date; host-club hosting counts are unaffected by this move.

checklist_findings.question: Lengde på turneringer?
checklist_findings.finding: rvv-0024 duration is unchanged: 130 minutes, 5 rounds, matching configured ice_time_minutes and round buffers. Confirmed via audit-evidence checklist item 3 for this tournament.

checklist_findings.question: Er det faktisk ledig tid på is?
checklist_findings.finding: Sandefjord's scraped calendar source is trusted and coverage-complete through 2027-03-28. On 2026-12-06 the only recorded events are the club's normal recurring off-window 'fast istid' blocks (00:00-15:00 and 18:00-24:00); the 15:00-18:00 tournament window is free, matching the same pattern that already existed around the prior 2026-10-31 placement. This is calendar observation, not yet an explicit club confirmation for the new date -- flagged as a remaining action.

checklist_findings.question: Deltar vertsklubben i samme turnering?
checklist_findings.finding: Yes: Sandefjord (host club Sandefjord Penguins) is listed among rvv-0024's 8 participating teams.

checklist_findings.question: Deltar hvert lag maksimalt én gang per dag?
checklist_findings.finding: Deterministic verification passed (ok=true, zero violations) for the full candidate including 2026-12-06; another tournament (rvv-0076, U8) also falls on 2026-12-06 but shares no team identity with rvv-0024 since team identity includes age group -- no team plays twice on that day.

checklist_findings.question: Er det normalt maks 2 lag fra samme klubb, med 3 kun som synlig unntak?
checklist_findings.finding: rvv-0024's roster is unchanged by the move: Frisk Asker has 2 teams (Frisk Asker 1 and 3), every other club has 1. No club exceeds the normal 2-team cap.

checklist_findings.question: Er eksportformatene konsistente?
checklist_findings.finding: export_consistency_summary reports all checks (csv_games, csv_overview, csv_team_counts, ical, excel) matching the plan with zero mismatches and zero unknowns.

checklist_findings.question: Ser harnesset andre materielle problemer eller manglende regler vi ikke allerede har tenkt på?
checklist_findings.finding: No new material problems introduced by this change. The deterministic publication_scope is ELIGIBLE, rvv-0024 is correctly classified as proposed (not booked) with no HELD/BLOCKED entries, and the published-to-canonical delta touches only rvv-0024's date field. Pre-existing season-wide REVIEW_REQUIRED reasons (hosting-balance imbalances, manual/external calendar placements, participation shortfalls, unplaced obligations) are unrelated historical planning debt, unaffected by this scoped move.
